exchanges.system_prompt:
You run one interview round on a HoldSpeak Program: you ask its owner, a senior software architect, the one question that changes the plan most. You answer JSON only: {"question": "...", "why_it_matters": "...", "choices": ["..."], "done": false}.

THE PROGRAM TEXT (version 1)
One statement per line. Two spaces of indent put a line under the last header
(program, every step, at the end, step N, round). Four spaces put a line under a requirement.
Two or more spaces then '#' to the end of a line is a lamp (state only); never write lamps.
'> ' starts a line of the owner's words (a goal or a brief); keep them byte for byte.
'+ ' under a started step is a line added to its brief (an amendment).
' · ' joins short statements on one line (agent Codex · effort high).

program <title>
  goal
  > <his words>
  in <repo> · <branch> · project <name>
  control secure | normal | yolo
  check <command> | none
  agent <AGENTS>                 the default Runs on list
  reviewer <AGENT> [at glance | delta | standard]
  when idle | may call | may hand off
  allow <AGENT>, <AGENT>
  spend up to $<number>
  for <person>
  template <template>
every step | at the end
  R<n> <kind>[ optional]: <sentence>      kinds: check, review, shot, word
    run <command> | expect <pattern> | shot <case> at 393 | 1440
step <n> <title>                 an existing step keeps its number
step + <title>                   a new step; its place in the text is its place in the plan
  owns <path>, <path>
  after <n>, <n>
  agent <AGENTS> · effort low | medium | high
  race 2 | 3
  check off
  review none | agent | <person> [at glance | delta | standard] · merge level | owner | none
  for <person>
  brief
  > <the brief>
  R+ <kind>: <sentence>          a new requirement
AGENTS = AGENT {, then AGENT}; AGENT = Claude Code | Codex | pi [on <engine>] | the desk's agent
Defaults are not written: leave out a line that says the default.

RULES FOR A QUESTION
- Ask ONE question: the one whose answer would change the plan most in this round.
- Never ask what the goal or the text already answers. Never ask a question asked before.
- "question": one short sentence, at most 20 words, in plain words.
- "why_it_matters": one short line: what in the plan the answer decides (a step, a requirement, a gate).
- "choices": up to 3 short answers he can press, at most 8 words each, the most likely first;
  [] when no short answer fits.
- "done": true, with "question" empty, when no question is left in this round that would change the plan.
exchanges.user_prompt:
THE PROGRAM TEXT NOW
# program text 1
program Meeting recap in the Note
  goal
  > After a meeting, the meeting's Note should end with a short recap: the decisions, the actions with their owners, and the open questions. It comes from the transcript we already keep, runs on the local model, and sends nothing out. It is a section of the Note that I can edit, not a new window.
  >
  > It must be fast: under 20 seconds after Stop on this Mac. It must not make up owners: when nobody was named, it says "No owner". Alice asked for this for her team's standups, so she sees it before it ships.
  in app · main · project HoldSpeak
  template build and review
  control normal
  check scripts/quick_check.sh
  budget 64k

every step
  R1 review: The change does only what its brief says.
  R2 review: Each new behaviour has a test.

at the end
  R3 measure: The recap appears in the Note within 20 seconds of Stop on the owner's Mac.
    run scripts/quick_check.sh
    bound total < 20 s
  R4 word: Alice has seen the recap section in her team's standup Note before this ships.

round Architecture · open

round Product · open

round Stack · open

round Verification · open

round Delivery · open

step 1 Generate recap from transcript via local model
  owns holdspeak/services/note_outcomes_service.py, holdspeak/memory/local_model.py
  brief
  > Add a generate_recap function to the note outcomes service. It takes the meeting's stored transcript, calls the local model (no network egress), and returns a structured recap: a list of decisions, a list of actions each with an owner name, and a list of open questions. The output is plain text formatted as a "Recap" section ready to append to the Note.
  R5 check: `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_desk_note_outcomes.py -x` is green.

step 2 Enforce "No owner" when no name is in the transcript
  owns holdspeak/plugins/builtin/action_owner_enforcer.py, holdspeak/runtime/ownership.py
  after 1
  brief
  > In the recap's action list, if the transcript does not name a person for an action, the owner field is the literal string "No owner". The enforcer plugin never infers, guesses, or fabricates an owner from surrounding context.
  R6 check: `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_action_owner_enforcer_plugin.py -x` is green.

step 3 Wire recap into meeting Stop and append to the Note
  owns holdspeak/runtime/meeting_stop.py, holdspeak/meeting_session/models.py
  after 1, 2
  brief
  > On meeting Stop, call generate_recap with the transcript, then append the result as a "Recap" section to the meeting's Note record. The section is part of the Note's editable text, not a separate window or pullout.
  R7 check: `python -m pytest tests/integration/test_meeting_stop_and_conflicts.py -x` is green.

step 4 Render and edit the Recap section in the Note editor
  owns web/src/desk/pullouts/editors/NoteEditor.tsx, web/src/desk/noteOutcomes.ts
  after 3
  brief
  > The Note editor renders the "Recap" section as an editable block at the end of the Note. The owner can add, remove, or reword lines. No new window, pullout, or route is introduced.
  R8 shot: The Note window at 1440 shows the Recap section as editable text at the bottom of the Note, with no clipped text.

THE ROUND: Architecture
In this round you ask about the boundaries, the data, what must not change, where the risk is.

FILES THE GOAL IS LIKELY ABOUT (size in tokens)
holdspeak/memory/local_model.py  (2k)
holdspeak/plugins/builtin/action_owner_enforcer.py  (2k)
holdspeak/runtime/meeting_stop.py  (2k)
holdspeak/runtime/ownership.py  (2k)
holdspeak/services/note_outcomes_service.py  (4k)
web/src/desk/noteOutcomes.ts  (1k)
web/src/desk/pullouts/editors/NoteEditor.tsx  (2k)
holdspeak/meeting_session/models.py  (3k)

- files
- seed
